column1: # Alex marks Mogall Forest; Lamakan is mud and heat.

column3:
The broken sign reads:{page_break}North: Fuchin Temple
South: Mogall Prairie...{page_break}Scratched below:
"Don't follow the lights at
night. They're awake."{end_wait}
Agh... The sand is mud\nnow, and it's still\nsweltering hot.{end_wait}
Every step sinks to the\nankle. This desert has\ndrowned and burned at once.{end_wait}
I can't stop sweating,\nand I can't stay dry.\nHow is that possible?{end_wait}
So much water, and not\none drop to drink.\nIt tastes of ash.{end_wait}
I can't keep my cool\nwhen the ground steams\nunder me.{end_wait}
Ew... My clothes are\ncaked in mud and sweat!\nThis is gross!{end_wait}
Aghh! I can't stand it!\nMy feet are burning and\nsoaked at once!{end_wait}
I can't take another\nminute of this! Where\nis the oasis?{end_wait}
If we find no oasis\nsoon, I'll sink into\nthis mud and vanish!{end_wait}
